Execute Block.description: Create and immediately execute a block

Named Function.description: Define a named function (block bound to a variable)

Call Function.description: Recall and execute a named function

Map.description: Map a block over a list

Filter.description: Filter a list by a predicate block

Fold.description: Fold/reduce a list with an initial value and combining block

Conditional.description: Conditional: drop value if condition is falsy

Ternary.description: Ternary: select one of two values based on condition

Let Bind.description: Bind a value to a variable

Compose.description: Compose/concatenate two blocks, lists, or strings

Write Line.description: Print top of stack with newline and consume it

Read Line.description: Read a line from stdin, push as string
